_var_limit_rationale: 0.25 matches CONSERVATIVE_PORTFOLIO. At 0.10 the gate was unsatisfiable: a 10-name long-only equity book has annualized sigma ~0.29, so portfolio_var (0.28-0.38) exceeded the limit on 9 of 10 days and risk_scale sat at 0.39, holding gross leverage to 0.3-3.2 pct of capital. Futures at 0.25 breaches on 4.7 pct of days and runs at ~91 pct of target size. Proven on every chain of the 2026-09 equities gate (E2 finding 02: the gate is scale-invariant, so a single held name with sigma > 0.25 binds it regardless of leverage).
